metadata.description: Late-stage learner with deep mathematics and physics coverage, competent computer science, and only an introductory brush with chemistry. Learns quickly and reviews little.
metadata.disclaimer: Synthetic research persona generated by stepzero.student_profiles. This is designed test material, not observed data, and it is not derived from or calibrated against any real student. It exists to give Project Step Zero v1.0 controlled, reproducible inputs for recommendation, simulation, and evaluation experiments, and is expected to be replaced or calibrated once primary research data is collected.
design_notes: Full mathematics coverage is what makes the deep physics track reachable at all.
Chemistry reach is deliberately shallow so the profile is strong but not uniformly strong.
probability_distributions is a deliberate gap from avoiding the statistics track.
euclidean_basics is deliberately forgotten, an early topic never revisited in years.
